author: felicepantaleo
body:
This PR is technical only and it changes nothing if the configuration is correct.

- **A test of the cut.** The check of `requireHits` in `TruthBranchRecoValidator` becomes `BranchHitAssociator::hasHitInDetectors`, with a unit test. Before, no test ran this check. The test covers a hit inside the mask, a hit outside the mask, the whole channel and a branch with no hit.
- **A missing associator is an error.** `customiseTruthBranchRequireHits` set `requireHits` with the default whole hit channel when the associator of a validator was not in the process, with no message. It now raises `RuntimeError`.
- **Harvesting.** A harvesting job fills no denominator, so the customise now changes nothing there. This also means the new error does not stop a harvesting job, which does not load the associators.
- **The error message.** An unknown detector name now gives `denominatorDetectors: unknown DetId::Detector name`.

#### PR validation:

- The new unit test fails when `hasHitInDetectors` ignores the mask, and passes with the code of this PR. It does not run the validator event loop.
- `customiseTruthBranchRequireHits_t` has 6 tests, 2 of them new. `requireHits_cfg.py` runs.
title: TruthInfo - requireHits: test the cut and stop on a missing associator
